notes: TMSEL: only primary government records found (RTA's audited statements), no news. They confirm TMSEL's ERISA minimum contributions went unmade 2013-2024, but give no $79.5M figure, and say the plan is fully funded on a GASB basis and that RTA disputes ERISA coverage. EIN 822871833: no fetched page ties this EIN to any plan name. A search-engine summary (from a 401k-lookup.com result that failed to load) said it is the St. Joseph Health Services of Rhode Island Retirement Plan. That plan went into receivership in 2017 and PBGC took it over in 2025 (35% funded, $88M underfunded per PBGC, Dec 2024). If the EIN is that plan, there is wide coverage, but the link is not verified. The Justia page for RTA v. TMSEL plan trustees (E.D. La. 2013) returned 403. No source found on the 631 plans / $426.7M national total.
